Name: explodableBushes
Author: maguc00
Description:
"explodableBushes" changes the explosion effect which allows it to destroy bushes, be it `Explosive Ammo`, `Bomb`; ... as long as it explodes and destroys objects it should be able to destroy the bushes.

However there are some things you have to consider. [color=#ff0000][b]Don't use it[/b][/color] if you:
[list=1]
[*] Care about bushes
[*]Are afraid of Softlocks
[*]Expect an polished Mod
[/list]
Bushes won't ever respawn if destroyed, [b][color=#ff0000]they stay destroyed[/color][/b] once saved and even if this mod is uninstalled.
Only Softlock I know currently about is with Krobus, if you destroy that bush before finishing that event, then [color=#ff0000][b]you won't be able to get the `Magnifiyng Glass`[/b][/color], but there could be probably more Softlocks.
This mod does not come with any settings or anything really, it just patches one game function and thats about it, so the Multiplayer experience might be the most questionable of all.
[color=#ff0000][b]If you expect an actual polished mod[/b][/color] with actual work put into it then there is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]﻿.
As of currently [color=#ff0000][b]Blowing up Golden Walnut Bushes won't yield any Golden Walnut! [/b][/color]Maybe I will change this one day, if I find some time.

So now after the gritty details are out of the way you might wonder why this mod even exists then. Well yes. The only real "benefit" here is its simplistic nature so far, if it can be called like that. There is not much under the hood that [i]"should"[/i] cause issues in the long run. But other than that there is not much to it, except its gimmick maybe.

[b][size=5]Dependency[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod [color=#ff0000]requires [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=#ff0000]SMAPI[/color][/url]﻿ 4.1.9+, only tested versions so far are 4.1.9, 4.1.10 and game version 1.6.14 Steam
[*]It might be possible to run it on lower SMAPI and game versions but I haven't tested it.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download `explodableBushes.zip`
[*]extract the folder `explodableBushes` from that zip into `StardewValley/Mods`

[*]The path should look like this: `StardewValley/Mods/explodableBushes/` and in there should be `manifest.json` and `explodableBushes.dll`

[/list]
[size=5][b]Known Conflicts[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]none known so far. `explodableBushes` patches the function `GameLocation.explode`, so if any other mod patches it too then some issues could occur.
[/list]

The source can be found [url=https://github.com/maguc00/explodableBushes/tree/main]here[/url].
